# Regression fixtures

This directory contains small synthetic or sanitized metadata fixtures used to
exercise parser boundaries. Real device images should not be committed here
unless redistribution rights are clear.

## Initial regression profile

- Device family: OnePlus Nord CE 3 5G
- SoC family: Qualcomm SM7325
- Architecture: AArch64
- Android generation: Android 15
- Kernel family: Linux 5.4

The profile is descriptive test context only. It is not an exploit-offset
database and does not contain executable privilege-escalation logic.
